See where RWN’s directory information comes from.

Structured public feeds, reviewed snapshots, and record-level original sources stay attributable. This page describes what RWN actually uses and how it was checked; inclusion does not imply sponsorship, endorsement, or a partnership with RWN.

What these labels mean: a structured source family has a documented refresh/audit model in RWN’s registry. “Record-level original source” means the listing keeps a cited publisher or provider source but is not represented as one of RWN’s structured feed/snapshot pipelines. Neither label means the source organization endorses or partners with RWN.

Structured feeds and reviewed snapshots

Live official query

USDA Summer Meals for Kids Site Finder — 2026

U.S. Department of Agriculture, Food and Nutrition Service
Audited 2026-08-05

17,442 active records at audit; loaded live only after a location search

Refresh model
State agencies submit at least three times each summer; USDA says its public finder is updated every Friday during the season.
Publication standard
Only geocoded records scoring at least 80, not marked dropped, and active on the search date are returned.
Location privacy
RWN rounds a user-approved location to one decimal degree before querying a 160 km search radius. Exact device coordinates stay in browser memory.
Reuse basis
Public official map endpoint. RWN queries bounded results live with attribution instead of republishing the full federal feed as a static copy.
Open original publisherOpen public data endpoint

Reviewed official-network snapshot

Trussell food-bank centres

Trussell
Audited 2026-08-07

1,398 records currently published by RWN

Refresh model
Refreshable from the current official Trussell finder; RWN's generator fails closed if the source becomes materially incomplete or changes format.
Fields used
Trussell-published coordinates, public address, town and postcode, phone and email when supplied, referral route, collection or delivery status, provider page
Reuse basis
Official Trussell finder snapshot with record-level UUIDs and attribution. RWN excludes hidden-address records and records that fail exact-location or publication checks.
